name: Toledo, Ohio (United States, 1994–2025)
description: Three vertical stripes of navy blue, white and navy blue with the seal of the City of Toledo in the centre.
history: Toledo's second flag, adopted in 1994 with the city seal on a blue and white field. It was replaced by Mark Yappueying's winning design, revealed on 7 January 2025.

features.role: seal of the City of Toledo
